title: Normandy: beyond the landing
hook: After D-Day, what kept the armies supplied?

predict.question: Which supply route still mattered at the end of June?

frames.heading: Landings
frames.text: Allied forces land on Normandy beaches.

frames.heading: Storm
frames.text: A storm damages the American harbor.

frames.heading: Beaches endure
frames.text: Beach supply continues; Cherbourg remains unusable.

reveal: The landing was the start of a supply problem. Artificial harbors helped, but the June storm damaged the American Mulberry. Beaches continued handling supplies while Cherbourg’s damaged port could not yet serve the armies. A captured port was not automatically a usable one.
limit: Schematic supply links, not ship tracks or a front line.

sources.section: Curatola, June 2025: Cherbourg, Mulberries, storm and beach logistics; USHMM D-Day for June 6
